_about: 3-27 (R1 fix 1): antiportal_2084 (scale 3, 96 px at 32 x scale) holds the keyhole, the yellow door
and the exit, and the key lies 48 px inside shock_agent_2048's 74 px ring, where the player dies but
a knight does not; every portal here is 116 px or more from the ring's centre. Left off the top
platform onto the middle one while knight B holds at wayB1. A portal in the key's pocket at (80,
185) and one at the knight's post (232.4, 186): the knight goes into the pocket and takes the key
(tick 622; a minion carries a key). A portal on the pillar and one on the player; from the pillar a
portal on the middle platform at (200, 180) and one over the knight, stuck against the pillar at
(89.4, 199): out it comes with the key and walks back to wayB0. A portal between the top platform
and the small block at (275, 120) and one on the player: the shock diamond is taken; left off the
block, and at the knight the diamond strikes it (tick 948) and the key drops and is taken. A portal
at (270, 120) and one walked into at (190, 186.3): out moving right, over the block and down by the
keyhole (unlocked 1045, the door gone 1132); right into the door. Won on tick 1166. Leans on G1 (the
knight never sees or shoots), G10 and G4.
